author: Casey Cruise
releaseNotes: SPIKE v0.2.2 (backfill of the Oct 23, 2026 standalone-tested build). Live-proved on the Living Room hub: detection leg answers driver calls at http://127.0.0.1:8080 (status IDLE); the arm timer set a deadline, fired unaided, and disarmed itself ("arm window expired", state cleared). Changes since v0.1.0: timed arm on the fleet upgrader model (arm = ceiling, never a trigger; disarm also on successful apply and at boot if expired); sandbox fixes (no System.currentTimeMillis, no URLEncoder - stock groovyc cannot see these; repo CI now sandbox-lints); applyArmedUntil shows "off" when disarmed instead of a stale deadline. Unproven: apply with an update pending; behavior on a Hub Login Security enabled hub.
